comparator.name: Astronomy (Sterrenkunde)
comparator.sourceNotes: The current requirements close 60+60+60. Year 3 contains 8 EC of required astronomy/research-skills study, a 22-EC research project split into 18+1+3 EC children counted once, and 30 EC of genuinely approved free-choice space. That space may be an approved minor, free/exchange study or relevant elective package, so no universal astronomy subject package is invented. Required upper-year modules establish Dutch and English instruction.
